record.final_answer:
The September 2026 total is **5437.50**.

The first run failed with `cannot create out/total-2026-09.txt: Directory nonexistent`. The script writes its result to `out/`, but that folder is in `.gitignore`, so a fresh checkout doesn't have it. I created it with `mkdir -p out`, left the script unchanged, and the second run worked. The total is also saved in `out/total-2026-09.txt`.

I added up the five rows in `data/2026-09.csv` by hand (1250.00 + 380.50 + 2210.75 + 96.25 + 1500.00) and got the same 5437.50. I also saved the missing-folder problem and its fix to memory so a later session doesn't hit the same error.
